positive_snippets: Had a great stay at Amahi Inn! The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff was friendly and helpful throughout the stay. Good location with easy connectivity and decent breakfast options. Overall, great value for money — would definitely recommend!

Our wedding party stayed at Amahi Inn, and the experience was truly flawless. From the comfort of the rooms to the quality of the food, everything was thoughtfully managed and exceeded our expectations. The staff was exceptionally courteous, responsive, and always willing to go the extra mile to ensure a smooth and pleasant stay for all our guests.
Managing a wedding group is never easy, but Amahi Inn handled it with warmth, efficiency, and professionalism. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to host our family and friends during such an important occasion. Highly recommended.

The service at the hotel was absolutely exceptional. The staff was polite, attentive, and always ready to help. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and every request was handled promptly. It truly made our stay comfortable and stress-free
